testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.data.sync.SyncTests

testcase.name: a job edited during a run is not committed over()
a repeated page of the same run is not applied twice()
backoff doubles from 30 seconds and is capped()
a job whose owner lost the permission pauses and pulls nothing()
losing the permission later keeps the checkpoint and the delivered records()
creating a job validates it against the approved query mapping and view model()
managing sync needs its permission and a denial looks the same for an unknown job()
a crash in the sink keeps the checkpoint and the retry delivers without duplicates()
audit records carry ids and counts and never a row value()
a run acts as the job owner with the workspace and request id of the job()
the next run asks only for what changed since the checkpoint()
records without a key are skipped and counted()
an authorizer outage pauses the job instead of running it()
first run pulls every page applies it and commits the checkpoint()
transient failures back off exponentially then pause and keep lastSuccess()
only one worker holds a job and an expired lease can be taken over but the old holder cannot commit()
another tenant cannot see run pause or delete a job()
tick runs due active jobs only and a successful sync invalidates cached queries and notifies()
a source that ignores the cursor is detected and the job pauses without moving the checkpoint()
resume revalidates and manual run is rate limited()
a permanent failure pauses at once and says why()
running the same data again changes nothing()
cursor comparison follows the field type()
